# Licenses allowed in anything that ships inside Clueless.app.
# scripts/third_party_notices.sh fails the build on any license not listed here,
# including "unknown", so a new copyleft dependency can't arrive unnoticed.
#
# Lines are SPDX identifiers. Lines of the form `package = SPDX` override a
# package whose metadata doesn't state its license in a machine-readable way;
# each override needs a comment saying where the license was confirmed.

MIT
MIT-CMU
BSD-2-Clause
BSD-3-Clause
Apache-2.0
ISC
0BSD
PSF-2.0
Python-2.0
Unlicense
CC0-1.0
Zlib
BlueOak-1.0.0
# File-level copyleft only; unmodified use in a bundle is fine.
MPL-2.0

# Overrides
# numpy's metadata is the full license text; it is BSD-3-Clause (LICENSE.txt in the wheel).
numpy = BSD-3-Clause
